brand.tagline: Fresh on the shelf, right on schedule.
brand.mission: Deliver committed restock shipments reliably and on time so retailers can promise their own customers freshness and never run dry.
brand.vision: A pantry where nothing runs out because the shipment was late — only because it sold.
values: On-time restock keeps quality at the centre of the shelf.
We ship to the schedule, because an empty shelf costs everyone.
Reliable volume in, honest communication out.
Right amount, right time, right place — less product thrown away.
Consumers trust a stocked shelf; we protect that every run.
brand.about: Maplehurst Foods moves committed restock shipments and consumer goods so retailers keep the shelf full. Our origin story is a produce manager's complaint — that good food kept arriving a day late and getting pushed to markdown. We built a restock operation on the opposite principle: committed delivery is verified, on time, and the shelf is the report card.
history: Founded in Cincinnati around a refrigerated truck and a promise.
Expanded from produce to the full food-and-bev restock line.
Automated restock scheduling to keep the shelf on time at scale.
leadership: Third-generation food distributor who built Maplehurst around freshness.
Owns the distributor network running today's restock.
testimonials: Markdown went from a weekly guessing game to a rounding error.
brand.locations: Cincinnati, OH (HQ) · distribution centres in 6 states
faq: Every committed shipment is tracked to a verified ledger completion — 'on time' is a measured fact, not a promise.
Can you handle frozen and fresh in one order?
Yes, our restock service spans the temperature range with verification on every leg.
brand.careers: Keep good food out of the markdown bin: logistics, food-safety, supply planning, route operations.
brand.investors: Privately held; family-owned. On-time reliability data on request.
brand.esg: Waste-reduction routing, food-recovery donations, fuel-efficient fleet, sustainable packaging for own-brand.
